newsitem.title: USA: Sagebrush Inc COO Michael Shubert resigns.
newsitem.headline: Sagebrush Inc COO Michael Shubert resigns.

text.p: Sagebrush Inc said Friday that Michael Shubert has resigned as its executive vice president and chief operating officer, effective April 25, to pursue other interests in the restaurant industry.

The company said that Shubert has also resigned from its board of directors, and that the board does not intend to nominate a replacement at its annual meeting, although it may fill the position later.
L. Dent Miller, president and chief executive officer, will assume the duties of chief operating officer, said the company, delegating additional responsibilities to other personnel.
Sagebrush owns and operates 28 "Sagebrush Steakhouse & Saloon" restaurants in North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee and Virginia and plans to open seven additional restaurants in 1997.
